content:
Leagues
* Are you able to specify league names, i.e. Wood/Bronze/etc. instead of Wood 4 to Wood 1, which seem to be the default? (Example: https://www.codingame.com/ide/puzzle/game-of-life-or-death )

Note: The comments below apply to all leagues unless otherwise specified.

Introduction
* Please ensure that the league names are correct.

* (Level 2 only) Please change "Free-For-All" to "free-for-all".

* (Level 3 only) Please remove "physical".

Goal
* Consider removing the word "official".

Rules (Levels 3 and 4)
* Rotate: Please keep the terms "counter-clockwise" and "clockwise".

* Please remove "physical".

Game Input/Output
* Please provide the following as initialisation input:
  • Number of players
  • Player ID

* Please format "." using the <const> tag instead of the <code> tag.

* (Levels 3 and 4) Please specify:

  • "A single line containing 4 space-separated values" for Option A.

  • "A single line containing 5 space-separated values" for Option B.

* (Levels 3 and 4) Please restore the descriptions of x, y, block and dir.

Constraints
* Please include the time limits.

Stub
* Please change the comment "'0' is player 0, '1' is player 1." to "'0' to '3' indicates a marble placed by the player with that ID."

* Please ensure that the league name "Silver league" is correct (it may be "Wood 2" instead).

Referee
* The "No output provided" exception can be removed as it's never triggered even when the output is an empty string (I assume this is because the `outputs` list is never empty).

Viewer
* Consider displaying past actions without the word "Played" and using a larger font size.

* Consider adding tooltips that display coordinates.

Your initial questions
* Since I don't spend much time playing multiplayer games, I think it's better for other players to share their opinions.

Thanks.

Here is Pentago Arena Edition! It’s based on an existing game but adapted for the Arena. :D

I have a few questions:

- As it stands, is it enough to make it a multi-league game? :O
- Should I add an extra action for the Gold League? Or plan for a larger board?
- Or would it be better to make all actions available right from the Bronze League?
- Should I allow two players on a 9x9 board?

Etc. :D

Any suggestions or comments are welcome! 

Enjoy! :)

No, it seems I don't have access to the league names; I renamed them.
Points addressed and pushed! :) Thanks!

Thank you! The updates look good. I only have a few minor suggestions left:

Game Input/Output
* Consider moving `size` to the initialisation input, since it remains constant throughout the game.

* Next `size` lines:
  • If `size` is moved to the initialisation input, you can remove the word "Next".

  • Please apply the "statement-lineno" formatting.

* Optional: Consider removing the SWAP keyword from the output format for consistency, since option A doesn't require a corresponding ROTATE keyword.

Thanks again.

All done! Thanks for the high-quality review, as always! :)
Perhaps I should also remove the "swap" keyword from the league ribbon?

You're welcome! 🙂

> league ribbon
Are you referring to the Level 3 (Wood 2) league introduction? If so, I'd suggest changing <action>SWAP</action> to simply SWAP, for consistency with the league preview section.

* I don't see the GitHub referee source updated yet. I assume the version on CG is more up to date?

* I have one remaining minor suggestion, but there's no need to address it immediately. It can wait, especially since the player counts and board sizes for each league may still change based on feedback from other reviewers.

  In the Input section, when a value is fixed, consider stating it directly instead of giving a range to avoid confusion:

  • Number of players: state 2 in Level 1, and 3 or 4 in the higher levels.

  • Player ID: state 0 or 1 in Level 1, and 0 to 3 in the higher levels.

  • Board size: state 6 in Level 1, and 9 in the higher levels.
